description: A newline before the parenthesis of a JSON static call is ignored
notes: The spec reads the string as a native syntax expression, where a newline between a function name and its opening parenthesis is only ignored inside parentheses, brackets and braces (native/functions/call-newline-before-parenthesis-is-error), without saying whether a string's content is such a context. hashicorp/hcl parses the string with hclsyntax.ParseExpression (expression.ExprCall in json/structure.go), which ignores newlines as if the content were in parentheses (hclsyntax/public.go).
